changelog:
belief-assessor v2 introduces major upgrades:

  - 4-way constraint system (contradiction, provenance, temporal, density) that 
    caps confidence and explains why via veto_reasons
  - Formula-based confidence intervals that adapt to evidence quality and quantity,
    replacing the fixed ±0.15 margin
  - 3 strategy presets (standard, conservative, permissive) + fully customizable
    thresholds via ProjectionConfig
  - Historical claim auto-detection — exempts past events from temporal decay
    unless actively challenged
  - Expanded benchmarks: 56 internal + 400 external (FEVER/PubHealth/LIAR),
    0 false positives across all datasets
summary: LLM-driven epistemic reasoning engine. Evaluates claims against evidence, outputs calibrated confidence and structured belief state (VERIFIED/CONTESTED/UNCER...
